headword: {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}
gloss: number of infected people; case count

definitions.gloss: number of infected people; number of cases
definitions.explanation: How many people have been confirmed to have caught a particular infectious disease, usually reported for a given day or region.

examples.japanese: {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}が{減|へ}ってきた。
examples.english: The number of infected people has been falling.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}の{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}は{百人|ひゃくにん}を{超|こ}えた。
examples.english: Yesterday's case count exceeded one hundred people.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}の{数|かず}が{限|かぎ}られているため、{発表|はっぴょう}された{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}は{実際|じっさい}より{少|すく}ないとみられる。
examples.english: Because the number of tests is limited, the announced case count is thought to be lower than the real figure.

notes:
{感染者|かんせんしゃ} (infected person) + {数|すう} (number, count). Became everyday news vocabulary during the coronavirus pandemic and is now the standard way of reporting case figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}が{増|ふ}える: for the number of cases to rise
- {新規|しんき}{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}: the number of new cases
- {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce the case count

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}: infection rate — a proportion rather than a headcount
- {死者数|ししゃすう}: death toll — the same {数|すう} pattern applied to deaths
